About this Event

STILLPOINT LIVE 
Life isn't going to stop being life. What can change is your capacity to meet it.
stillpoint live is a live experience of breath, sound, somatics, and stillness — practiced together, in one room. Not a performance you watch. A practice you do.
Over the course of the evening you'll move through the Stillpoint arc:
Root: arrive, ground, moveBreathe: open, expand, regulateFeel: notice, listen, stay presentRelease: let go of what you're holdingLand: settle, integrate, stillnessIt's a place to practice staying present through sensation, intensity, and emotion, so you leave knowing what presence feels like, and carrying tools for when real life asks the same.
Not escape. Not avoidance. Resilience.
Practice it here. Live it out there.
